claim: US Judge Amy Coney Barrett graduated at the top of her law school class at Notre Dame Law School
justification: The high-confidence, corroborated evidence from both fact-checks consistently indicates Amy Coney Barrett graduated from Notre Dame Law School in 1997 and was ranked first in her class, receiving the Hoynes Prize for the best academic record. The low-confidence evidence that contradicts this (e.g., claiming she never graduated or earned her J.D. elsewhere) is explicitly flagged as fabricated or erroneous, and therefore is not used to anchor the verdict.
